ValidationRule.description: Restricting creation of recoveries on closed cases, still can edit the existing recoveries on closed case. Jira: CRM-5617 Update for QCC API Integration user JIRA CRM-5697
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', TEXT(Case_Number__r.Status) = 'Closed', ISNEW(), NOT( AND( ($Profile.Name = 'QCC API Integration user'), TEXT(Case_Number__r.Origin) = 'Red App')),
($UserRole.Name = 'QF-QDC') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This case is either closed or the recovery finalised or submitted for finalisation
